reproduction_command:
from scripts import diag_p106b_subject_role as d
import json
selection=json.loads((d.ROOT/'handoff/audit/WIP_20261019_SUBJECT_ROLE_DISPLAY_SAMPLE_SELECTION.json').read_text());ids=[e['id'] for e in selection['selected_entries']]
frozen,rows,bundles=d.read_prepared();natural={v['root']:v for v in rows['test']};output={'models':{},'pairs':{},'display':[]}
gate=d.stage_report(d.EVIDENCE/'readback.json');assert gate['status']=='RAW_READBACK_COMPLETE_NO_AUTOMATIC_ADOPTION' and gate['errors']==0
actual={}
for arm in d.ARMS:
 p=d.EVIDENCE/('evaluate_'+arm)/'report.json';r=d.stage_report(p);events=d.read_shards(d.LOCAL/('evaluate_'+arm),r['answer_manifest'],'answers',1758);actual[arm]={e['id']:e for e in events}
 output['models'][arm]=dict(summary=r['summary'],rank_summary=r['rank_summary'],native=r['native32_fp32'],seconds=r['whole_seconds'],report_sha256=d.digest(p),report_bytes=p.stat().st_size,core=r['core_before'],core_unchanged=r['core_before']==r['core_after'],checkpoint_sha256=r['lineage']['checkpoint_sha256'],answer_manifest=r['answer_manifest'],rank_manifest=r['rank_manifest'])
for k in ('role_only_minus_ce','all_axes_minus_ce','all_axes_minus_role_only'):output['pairs'][k]=gate[k]
for i in ids:
 c=actual['ce'][i]['case'];assert all(actual[a][i]['case']==c for a in d.ARMS)
 prompt=d.natural_data.text(c['messages'][0]);is_natural=c['lane']=='natural'
 v=dict(id=i,lane=c['lane'],language=c['language'],view=c.get('view',0),group_id=c['group_id'],question_index=c.get('question_index'),question=natural[c['root']]['question'] if is_natural else prompt,gold_or_aliases=c.get('gold',c.get('aliases')),prompt_sha256=d.natural_data.sha(c['messages']),context_sha256=d.natural_data.sha(natural[c['root']]['context']) if is_natural else None,full_context_not_republished=is_natural,answers={a:dict(answer=actual[a][i]['answer'],finish=actual[a][i]['generation']['finish_reason'],generated_tokens=actual[a][i]['generation']['generated_tokens']) for a in d.ARMS})
 output['display'].append(v)
assert len(output['display'])==40
output.update(readback_sha256=d.digest(d.EVIDENCE/'readback.json'),readback_bytes=(d.EVIDENCE/'readback.json').stat().st_size,display_selection_sha256=selection.get('selection_sha256'),selection_file_sha256=d.digest(d.ROOT/'handoff/audit/WIP_20261019_SUBJECT_ROLE_DISPLAY_SAMPLE_SELECTION.json'),new_model_calls=0)
print(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=False))
